description: Direct sale to end consumers from own or partner retail outlets
data_source: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
notes: Fastest cash conversion; limited by catchment size

description: Sale in bulk to distributors who reach retail
data_source: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
notes: Volume scale at the cost of margin and end-customer relationship

description: Direct supply to industrial or institutional buyers on contract
data_source: Office of Development Commissioner (MSME); MSME-DI project profiles
notes: Requires quality certification and often vendor registration

description: Conversion work or component supply to a principal manufacturer
data_source: Office of Development Commissioner (MSME); MSME-DI project profiles
notes: Stable order flow, high concentration risk

description: Sale to government buyers through the national procurement platform
notes: Udyam registration enables MSME benefits including purchase preference

description: Sale through conventional tendering outside GeM
data_source: Ministry of Finance; state procurement rules
notes: Public Procurement Policy reserves a share of procurement for MSEs

description: Third-party seller listing on the Amazon India marketplace
notes: Commission, returns and advertising cost materially compress margin

description: Third-party seller listing on the Flipkart marketplace
notes: Same margin structure considerations as other marketplaces

description: Sale through the Open Network for Digital Commerce interoperable network
notes: Designed to lower platform dependence; adoption still maturing

description: Direct-to-consumer sale through an owned website or social commerce
notes: Highest margin retention, highest customer acquisition cost

description: Sale to overseas buyers directly or through merchant exporters
notes: Import Export Code mandatory; certification is the binding constraint
